question: What happens to a wise person when the tip of nectar is burned by the essence of juice?
premises: the tip of nectar is mentioned
the essence of juice acts upon it
even a wise person is affected
inference: the verse warns that the nectar-tip process can burn even the wise
uncertainties: whether dahyamāna describes the nectar or the person
plain_english: Even a wise person is burned at the tip of nectar by the essence of juice.
